9.3 Sequence chart for ProtectionHook
Figure 9.3: ProtectionHook sequence chart
The sequence shows the flow of control if a protection error occurs. Depending on the
return values of the ProtectionHook, either the faulty Task/ISR is forcibly terminated
or the OS-Application is forcibly terminated or the system is shut down.
caption: 9.3 Sequence chart for ProtectionHook

targets.why: terminates task on protection hook return
terminates application on protection hook return
shuts down system on protection hook return
